## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), per the DCO.
- [ ] `just lint`, `just typecheck`, `just test`, and `just build` pass locally.
- [ ] New behavior has a test; a bug fix has a regression test.
- [ ] New source files have SPDX copyright and license headers.
- [ ] No emojis in code, comments, docs, commit messages, or UI text.
- [ ] The renderer still does no network or filesystem access of its own.
- [ ] Docs are updated if a contract, recipe, or user-visible behavior changed.
